NALTP Archive · the postseason

Playoffs

Every bracket the archive holds, round by round: who played whom, how the series went, and every game of it. The league’s own schedule stops at the last week of the season, so the postseason is read from the season hubs’ own playoff tabs from Season 27 on, and before that from the brackets the league drew in its two playoff history workbooks, which record who went through but not by how much. A score opens the archive’s own page for that match, where tagpro.eu and the cell of the hub that wrote the score down are both linked.
